Enum Class ActionIconKey

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ActionIconKey>
uno.anahata.asi.swing.icons.ActionIconKey
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ActionIconKey>, Constable
public enum ActionIconKey extends Enum<ActionIconKey>
Semantic identity of an action-button icon across the Anahata Swing UI.

Decouples action button rendering from concrete icon implementations, allowing host IDE environments (such as IntelliJ IDEA via AllIcons) to supply native, theme-adaptive iconography while falling back to Anahata vector icons in standalone and NetBeans environments.

Author:
anahata
